title: Card King Warden
description: Turns sculk and the Warden into Deltarune chapter 1 references
body:
This pack takes everything related to sculk and turns it into a reference to Deltarune Chapter 1, most notably turning the warden into the King.

- Warden = Card King (Or just "King")
- Echo shard = Glowshard
- Recovery compass = "SAVE Detector" (which I just made up)
- Disc 5 = Chaos King
- Mourner pot sherd = Digging Implement pot sherd
- Ward armor trim = Usurp armor trim
- Silence armor trim = Shadow armor trim

This also changes splash texts, as well as lang files in all non-joke versions of English.
